sections.content: Use es necesario que, hace falta que, es importante que and conviene que + present subjunctive to discuss actions needed to prevent or address a problem.

items.spanish: Es necesario que actuemos antes de que el problema se agrave.
items.english: It is necessary that we act before the problem gets worse.

items.spanish: Hace falta que las autoridades prevengan nuevas averías.
items.english: The authorities need to prevent new breakdowns.

items.spanish: Es importante que abordemos la causa del problema.
items.english: It is important that we address the cause of the problem.

items.spanish: Conviene que se adopten medidas antes del invierno.
items.english: It is advisable that measures be adopted before winter.

sections.content: Use the subjunctive after a necessity or recommendation expression with que.
